day_shape: UNSC Yemen session with UK statement pressing Iran over Houthi support, dueling Strait of Hormuz claims from Trump and IRGC's Khatam Al-Anbiya, repeated IDF strikes in Khan Younis including a Hamas company commander, and heavy Khamenei/IRIB Imam Reza mourning cycle.

threads.label: Yemen at UN Security Council
threads.summary: The UN Security Council held its 10208th meeting on Yemen with briefings from Special Envoy Hans Grundberg and OCHA, and UK Deputy PR Kate Foster delivered a statement calling on Iran to cease support for the Houthis. Jerusalem Post reported Saudi Arabia is considering backing a Yemeni ground campaign to retake the Red Sea coast, while Defa Press and IRIB carried Sana'a warnings to Riyadh.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz dueling claims
threads.summary: An IRGC Khatam Al-Anbiya spokesman said via Defa Press that no ship can safely transit the Strait of Hormuz without Iran's permission and supervision. Jerusalem Post reported an Iranian official's statement that the Strait is 'under Iran's control and management' following Donald Trump's claim of 'total control', and Iran International reported a Chamber of Commerce warning that 2,500 trucks would be needed to replace a single blockaded ship.

threads.label: IDF Khan Younis strikes resume
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed a strike in Khan Younis killing a Hamas company commander it said was planning attacks on Israeli forces, with Palestinian media reporting one dead in a motorcycle strike. Jerusalem Post described it as the second 'attack of choice' in two days after a pause since the late-July US-Hamas deal, and Defa Press reported the killing of Gaza's police chief in a separate Israeli drone strike.

threads.label: Lebanon disarmament and IDF withdrawal dispute
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported that senior US and Israeli officials denied a Reuters report that Israel and Lebanon had agreed on countries to participate in a mechanism overseeing Hezbollah disarmament. After Defence Minister Israel Katz said the IDF 'will not withdraw' from security zones, Washington clarified that a permanent military presence in southern Lebanon is inconsistent with the understandings.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressure and Khamenei mourning cycle
threads.summary: Iran International reported at least 42 businesses sealed in a renewed hijab crackdown, a suspended Kerman petrol price hike, and warnings that the Caspian Sea has hit a 200-year low. Khamenei's office and IRIB circulated a message marking Imam Reza's martyrdom addressed to 'the father of the nation's martyrs' and their companions attacked by the enemy.

events.title_en: Asian youth weightlifting; record-breaking with a taste of gold and silver
events.summary_en: Asian youth weightlifting; record-breaking with a taste of gold and silver. World youth weightlifting championships concluded with 6 precious medals and record-breaking for Iran's representatives. In the continuation of the youth and junior Asian weightlifting championships in Tashkent, Iran's representatives in the 95+ kilogramme youth category took to the platform, and Taha Noojavaan with a brilliant performance managed to win three gold medals and set several Asian and world records. Taha Noojavaan began his snatch movement by successfully lifting 165 and 170 kilogrammes, and on his third attempt also lifted 176 kilogrammes overhead. With this record, whilst winning the snatch gold medal, he set the Asian and world record.

events.title_en: Joint message from Egypt and the UAE to America and Iran
events.summary_en: Joint message from Egypt and the UAE to America and Iran. Badr Abdelati, Egypt's Foreign Minister, and Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan, his UAE counterpart, today Thursday called on America and the Islamic Republic of Iran in a telephone conversation to return to the agreement signed between them last June. The two ministers emphasised the importance of increasing efforts to reduce tensions and contain the crisis and return to the commitments contained in the agreement between America and Iran so that the ground is prepared for resuming political and diplomatic channels and preventing the expansion of confrontation. The foreign ministers of Egypt and the UAE also stressed the necessity of halting the Zionist regime's tension-escalating actions and procedures on the West Bank and countering.

events.title_en: 16.5 per cent of Tehran subscribers consume 40 per cent of the province's electricity. Mahmudi, CEO of Tehran province's electricity distribution company:
events.summary_en: 16.5 per cent of Tehran subscribers consume 40 per cent of the province's electricity. Mahmudi, CEO of Tehran province's electricity distribution company: Last year, 77 per cent of the province's subscribers followed the electricity consumption pattern. This year, with people's cooperation and participation, this figure has increased to 83.5 per cent. 16.5 per cent of subscribers consume more than the pattern and 40 per cent of the province's electricity. If subscribers reduce their electricity consumption by 10 per cent, we will not need load management and planned blackouts. More than 600,000 smart metres have been installed across this province. In Tehran province there is capacity to replace one million water-cooled air conditioner motors with these low-consumption motors.

events.title: Caspian Sea hits 200-year low as Iran debates the treaty meant to divide it
events.summary: The Caspian Sea is falling by as much as 20 centimeters a year and stands at its lowest level in two centuries, an Iranian environment official said, a warning that lands just as Tehran reopens the argument over how to divide a sea that is shrinking on all five of its owners.

events.title_en: Continuation of reciprocal clashes in Yemen
events.summary_en: Continuation of reciprocal clashes in Yemen. Yemeni military sources reported a drone strike on the positions of Saudi-affiliated militias in Hadramawt province; simultaneously, reports emerged of reciprocal attacks by Riyadh-affiliated forces in various parts of Yemen and naval clashes between Saudi boats and Ansarallah forces. According to Thursday reports citing IRNA, citing Al-Arabiya network, a Yemeni military source announced that Ansarallah forces, using drones, targeted the positions of Saudi-affiliated forces in the Al-Abr area in Hadramawt province, in which operation two people were killed and 15 others wounded.

events.title_en: Torrential rainfall in Japan
events.summary_en: Torrential rainfall in Japan. Heavy rainfall and widespread thunderstorms in the Tokyo region and Chiba prefecture in Japan have created emergency conditions. Japan's meteorological agency has issued alert level 5, the highest rainfall warning level, for several cities including Ichikawa and Chiba. Rainfall intensity in Ichikawa and surrounding areas was such that emergency alerts were sent to residents' mobile phones and concerns over flooding and landslides have increased.

events.title_en: Al-Akhbar: Sana'a with preemptive battle on the western coast neutralised plans to seize Bab Al-Mandeb
events.summary_en: Al-Akhbar: Sana'a with preemptive battle on the western coast neutralised plans to seize Bab Al-Mandeb. Information obtained by Lebanon's Al-Akhbar newspaper shows that the intensification of preemptive tensions of Sana'a forces on the western coast is due to concerns about Saudi Arabia's preparedness and its coordination with Washington and London for a large-scale battle against the Houthis and Bab Al-Mandeb fronts aimed at reasserting control over shipping in the Red Sea. After receiving information that Saudi Arabia, in coordination with America and Britain, had begun preparations for a large-scale battle from south to north of Houthis, Sana'a forces began bombarding Saudi weapon depots on the western coast. According to information.

events.title: Land routes cannot replace Iran’s blocked sea trade, chamber official warns
events.summary: Replacing a single ship carrying essential goods to Iran would require about 2,500 trucks, a Chamber of Commerce official warned, saying land routes cannot offset the US maritime blockade and negotiations are the only realistic way to restore trade.

events.title: A Palestinian terror operative who crossed the "Yellow Line" in the southern Gaza Strip yesterday and approached troops was shot, the military says. The IDF says the operative was spotted by soldiers of the Paratroopers Brigade who are stationed in the area. The operative approached the paratroopers "in a manner that posed an immediate threat, and the soldiers then opened fire "to remove the threat," the army says. "A hit was identified," the IDF adds.
events.summary:
